name: World Research Integrity 2026 — Who's Breaking Science

1d20f8b72077ff7a.h:
Rank #1 · documented scale: tier 1

Wiley / Hindawi

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Hoboken, US
Documented scale: 11,300+ retractions
Detail: After Wiley bought Hindawi (2021), paper mills flooded its special issues; Wiley retracted 11,300+ papers and had 19 journals delisted by Clarivate.
Wiley discontinued the Hindawi brand in 2024; cleanup cost an estimated $35-40M.

8c04b2cbb6f7b63b.h:
Rank #2 · documented scale: tier 1

OMICS Publishing Group

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: Hyderabad, IN
Documented scale: $50.1M US court judgment
Detail: A US court ordered OMICS to pay $50.1M (2019) after the FTC proved deceptive practices: fake peer review, hidden fees, bogus impact factors and misused researcher names.
The archetypal predatory publisher; also runs Allied Academies, Pulsus, iMedPub, Longdom.

e2d663920bf7c10d.h:
Rank #3 · documented scale: tier 2

Cabells Predatory Reports

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: Beaumont, US
Documented scale: 15,000+ journals flagged
Detail: The successor to Beall’s List; catalogues over 15,000 journals using deceptive or predatory practices.
A catalogue, not one firm — a measure of the predatory long tail.

94c612d5d874bfbe.h:
Rank #4 · documented scale: tier 2

IEEE

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Piscataway, US
Documented scale: Thousands of papers removed
Detail: Has withdrawn thousands of substandard or fabricated conference papers from IEEE Xplore, including computer-generated (SCIgen) nonsense papers.
The world's largest technical professional body; mostly a conference-proceedings problem.

7ed672f122779b4f.h:
Rank #5 · documented scale: tier 2

Springer Nature

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Berlin, DE
Documented scale: Thousands of retractions
Detail: Repeated mass retractions across BMC, the Arabian Journal of Geosciences and others for fake peer review and paper-mill content.
A leading legitimate publisher; several journals were infiltrated and later purged.

6139802510a70003.h:
Rank #6 · documented scale: tier 2

MDPI

High-volume megajournal (criticised)
Based: Basel, CH
Documented scale: Megajournal; 2 journals delisted
Detail: High-volume special-issue model; its IJERPH published ~17,000 papers in 2022; Clarivate delisted 2 MDPI titles and China's CAS put 22 on a warning list.
MDPI rejects paper-mill claims and says delistings were on a 'content-relevance' criterion, not quality.

6055fe69911ce7fe.h:
Rank #7 · documented scale: tier 2

Elsevier

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Amsterdam, NL
Documented scale: Hundreds+ retractions
Detail: Paper-mill-infiltrated special issues and fake peer review have triggered retractions across multiple Elsevier journals.
The largest scientific publisher; targeted by mills like everyone else.

3fee204af6a5a346.h:
Rank #8 · documented scale: tier 2

Beall's-listed predatory publishers

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: (global list)
Documented scale: 1,000+ publishers catalogued
Detail: Beall's List and its successor lists catalogued well over 1,000 predatory open-access publishers and journals that charge fees with little or no real peer review.
A category, not one firm; the long tail of pay-to-publish operations.

7c8c3a0c65ccb428.h:
Rank #9 · documented scale: tier 2

WASET

Predatory conference organiser
Based: Istanbul, TR
Documented scale: Predatory conferences & journals
Detail: The World Academy of Science, Engineering and Technology is widely flagged for predatory conferences and journals using copied names and fake metrics.
Investigated by journalists across Europe (e.g. the 2018 'Fake Science' exposes).

a4a1c44ae9ca2825.h:
Rank #10 · documented scale: tier 3

Frontiers

High-volume megajournal (criticised)
Based: Lausanne, CH
Documented scale: Megajournal; integrity criticism
Detail: Very high volume with heavy China exposure; once appeared on Beall's predatory list; criticised for pressure on editors. Cut output sharply after 2022.
Frontiers disputes the predatory label; no mass-retraction event like Hindawi's.

605ad9d97e037548.h:
Rank #11 · documented scale: tier 3

SCIRP (Scientific Research Publishing)

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: Wuhan, CN
Documented scale: Long predatory-listed
Detail: Scientific Research Publishing has long appeared on predatory-publisher lists for weak review and aggressive fee-seeking.

6cfa95468a0b8515.h:
Rank #12 · documented scale: tier 3

Taylor & Francis

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Abingdon, GB
Documented scale: Journal delisted; 86+ retractions
Detail: Its journal Bioengineered was delisted by Clarivate after paper-mill activity, with 86+ retractions there alone.
A major legitimate publisher with infiltrated titles.

82dbb9a9b7be9317.h:
Rank #13 · documented scale: tier 3

PLOS (PLOS ONE)

High-volume megajournal (criticised)
Based: San Francisco, US
Documented scale: Hundreds of retractions
Detail: PLOS ONE, long the world’s largest journal, has retracted hundreds of papers, many for image manipulation and integrity failures.
A nonprofit open-access pioneer; sheer volume left a large cleanup.

d3a3bcc120407982.h:
Rank #14 · documented scale: tier 3

Scientific Reports (Springer Nature)

High-volume megajournal (criticised)
Based: Berlin, DE
Documented scale: World’s largest journal; hundreds of retractions
Detail: Publishes ~20,000 papers a year and has accumulated hundreds of retractions for manipulation and paper-mill content.

d5de51eecdedfa49.h:
Rank #15 · documented scale: tier 3

e-Century Publishing

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Madison, US
Documented scale: Mass paper-mill retractions
Detail: Its biomedical journals saw mass retractions for paper-mill and image-duplication content; several were delisted.

006e2b4b6a15d16a.h:
Rank #16 · documented scale: tier 3

Sage

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Thousand Oaks, US
Documented scale: Hundreds of retractions
Detail: Retracted 209 + 122 papers from one engineering journal for compromised peer review; earlier exposed a 2014 fake-peer-review ring.

8e3c455bf8c92e85.h:
Rank #17 · documented scale: tier 3

Bentham Open

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: Sharjah, AE
Documented scale: Predatory-listed (since 2009)
Detail: Subject of a famous 2009 sting when a deliberately nonsensical computer-generated paper was accepted.

a477eb678f45b940.h:
Rank #18 · documented scale: tier 3

Allied Academies / Pulsus

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: London, GB
Documented scale: OMICS-owned
Detail: Acquired by OMICS; carries the same predatory journal and conference practices.

511723897174e228.h:
Rank #19 · documented scale: tier 4

Spandidos Publications

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Athens, GR
Documented scale: Image-duplication retractions
Detail: Greek biomedical publisher hit by waves of image-duplication retractions flagged by integrity sleuths.

a1fd359da94b99c3.h:
Rank #20 · documented scale: tier 4

AME Publishing Company

Major publisher hit by paper mills
Based: Hong Kong, CN
Documented scale: Journals delisted (2023)
Detail: Several AME journals were removed from Clarivate’s Web of Science in the 2023 purge.

1bc48109538631fa.h:
Rank #21 · documented scale: tier 4

Science Publishing Group

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: New York, US
Documented scale: Predatory-listed
Detail: Open-access publisher long flagged for minimal review and deceptive metrics.

b4963cd43412e358.h:
Rank #22 · documented scale: tier 4

David Publishing

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: El Monte, US
Documented scale: Predatory-listed
Detail: Mass solicitation and pay-to-publish journals across many fields.

10098170c87ea3c4.h:
Rank #23 · documented scale: tier 4

Academic Journals

Predatory publisher (sanctioned/listed)
Based: Lagos, NG
Documented scale: Predatory-listed
Detail: High-volume open-access publisher repeatedly listed as predatory.
